info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Banking Accounts Statements-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Account Statements Retrieval API enables financial institutions and third-party developers to access detailed statements for banking accounts. This endpoint provides a comprehensive view of transaction history, balances, and account activities, facilitating effective account management and reporting. Typical users include banking applications, financial analytics tools, and customer service platforms that require reliable access to account information. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance user engagement and streamline their financial services.

get.description: Fetches the statements associated with the specified account, providing detailed information about transactions, balances, and other account activities for a specified period.

requestBody.description: This request retrieves account statements in JSON format. Ensure that all required parameters are correctly set to receive the desired statement data.

200.description: Returns the requested account statements successfully.
